sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy Home And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Virendra Mishra,Om Bhardwaj

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

Despite notice,
none has appeared for the complainant.
2. The FIR in question was lodged as a missing person report.
Subsequently, the victim in her statement under Section 161 & 164 Cr.P.C., did not support the prosecution story and admitted that she was in love with the applicant.
The age of the victim as per the medical examination is 18 years.
3. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

4. Considering the statements made by the victim coupled with the fact that the applicant is in custody since 14.07.2022 and has no criminal antecedent, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
1 5. Let the applicant Kailash be released on bail in FIR No.240 of 2022, under Section 363, 366, 376,
504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 & 7/8 of POCSO Act, P.S. Gauriganj, District Amethi on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
